title: A unit-compatible Cech Koszul comparison on one ringed site
statement: Let C be a small site with topology J, O a sheaf of commutative rings, and b a list of r global sections, allowing r=0. Assume derived categories of O-module sheaves and of their strict natural-number inverse towers. With the actual complexes, strict tensor tower, units, and presentation structure of [def-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-system], there exist a presentation D and a natural isomorphism theta from RHom(C_b,-) to D.completion carrying the actual Cech unit to D.unit on every derived object. This assertion neither chooses slice comparisons nor asserts their uniqueness.

source.place: sites-cohomology.tex Tag 0A0A, lemma-colim-and-lim-of-duals; Tag 0941, lemma-derived-limit-is-ok; more-algebra.tex Tag 0913, lemma-extended-alternating-Cech-is-colimit-koszul; derived.tex Tag 0949, lemma-colim-hocolim

proof.text: 1. Evaluate the transposed strict tensor tower at each index. Its map is the tensor map with the finite dual Koszul complex. The K-flatness theorem and the tensor mapping-cone isomorphism show that this sends quasi-isomorphisms to quasi-isomorphisms.

2. Descend that actual strict tensor tower by the localization lifting universal property. Use its localization factorization, and take total right derived inverse limit and its comparison from the strict-tower theorem. These fields explicitly construct a RingedKoszulLimitPresentation; no arbitrary witness of an existence theorem is used to define its tensor tower.
3. Apply the prescribed-presentation telescope/Hom comparison to this concrete presentation. Its unit equation supplies the asserted equation.

proof_origin.note: Separated from the normalized comparison existence argument; finite-complex and categorical glue are written explicitly in Lean.

theorem exists_ringed_cech_koszul_comparison_on_site :
    ∃ (D : RingedKoszulLimitPresentation O r b)
      (theta : ringedCechCompletionFunctor O (ringedExtendedCech O r b).1 ≅ D.completion),
      ∀ E, ringedCechCompletionUnit O (ringedExtendedCech O r b).1
        (ringedExtendedCech O r b).2 E ≫ theta.hom.app E = D.unit E
